query:
SELECT 
  saleType,
  COUNT(*) as count,
  SUM(finalAmount) as totalAmount,
  MIN(saleDate) as firstSale,
  MAX(saleDate) as lastSale
FROM sales 
WHERE saleDate >= '2024-12-31 00:00:00' AND saleDate <= '2024-12-31 23:59:59'
  AND status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY saleType
ORDER BY saleType
